xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4605: A PR opened outside a pipeline workspace is never reviewed and nobody is told

plan.title: A PR opened outside a pipeline workspace is never reviewed and nobody is told
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: handlePullRequest in src/lib/webhook-handlers.ts starts the review pipeline for an opened or readied non-draft feature/ PR, but when the review starter returns started:false (reason no-workspace) it only console.logs. PRs opened from supervised handoff worktrees (pan handoff --cwd) have no workspaces/feature-<issue> worktree, so they are never verified or reviewed and nobody is told; pan review request then fails with 'Workspace does not exist'. The handoff worktrees are worktrees of the primary checkout, so the PR branch is usually still checked out elsewhere. The pipeline journal cannot be written without a workspace, and Command Deck's Needs-you group reads derived attention, not activity entries. createWorktree also re-cuts an unfetched remote feature branch from main.
narratives.Proposal: Adopt the PR branch into a pipeline workspace when the starter reports no-workspace: fetch feature/<issue>, verify the fetched ref equals the PR head, refuse if the branch is checked out in another worktree, reconcile the local branch (create / equal / fast-forward / refuse when diverged), call createWorkspace, assert workspace HEAD equals the PR head, journal workspace.adopted, then start the review pipeline. Never push, force, or delete. Every refusal is announced once via surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou, and a new derived attention 'pr-outside-pipeline' (with prOutsidePipeline { prNumber, fix, worktreePath? }) puts the issue under Command Deck's Needs you with the exact fix and is printed by pan show. The /api/review/:issueId/request route adopts too, so the fix text 'git worktree remove …, then pan review request' works. createWorktree fetches the feature branch first. See .pan/drafts/PAN-4605.md (D1-D11, WI-1..WI-11).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Adopting strike/, bypass/, or mixed-case branches (only exact feature/<issue-lower>)
- Forcing a checkout, removing the other worktree, deleting any branch, or pushing as part of adoption
- Adoption for polyrepo projects (refused with a pan workspace create fix)
- Surfacing review-start reasons other than no-workspace (dirty-workspace, already-running, no-project) from the webhook
- Starting review on reopened or synchronize webhook actions
- Kanban NeedsYouStrip / simple-mode projection of the new attention
- Routing changes-requested feedback to the handoff conversation that owns the branch
- Changing the /api/review/:issueId/trigger route or the dashboard Review button for issues with no workspace
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row
- Adopting GitLab merge requests (findOpenPipelinePr returns none for a GitLab project)

autoDecisions.summary: The pipeline-journal entry is written only when a workspace exists (workspace.adopted on success, workspace.adoption-failed when a failure leaves a workspace); a failure with no workspace is made visible by a derived attention instead.
autoDecisions.rationale: appendPipelineEntry skips writes when the workspace directory does not exist (pipeline-journal.ts ~L80), so the issue's literal 'append a journal entry' cannot land without resurrecting a ghost directory; a derived attention follows the PAN-4399 work-not-started precedent and keeps the 'store nothing derivable' invariant.

autoDecisions.summary: Needs-you visibility = new derived IssueAttention 'pr-outside-pipeline' rendered in Command Deck's Needs-you group, state badge and pan show, plus one surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou announcement at refusal time.
autoDecisions.rationale: Command Deck's Needs-you group (isNeedsYouFeature) reads derived.attention; surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou is the established 31-caller announcement door but only emits an activity entry. The derived signal also catches PRs opened while the dashboard was down and clears itself when a workspace appears.

autoDecisions.summary: POST /api/review/:issueId/request asks answerMissingWorkspace before any approved-head/nudge/breaker shortcut: an unmerged issue with no workspace and an open pipeline-branch PR (read fresh with gh pr list --head) is adopted (202 adopting:true); no PR → 400 + hint; forge failure → 503.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's fix text for the checked-out case is 'git worktree remove …, then pan review request'; without route adoption that command would still fail with 'Workspace does not exist'. review-pipeline.ts is 983 lines and lint-file-size.sh passes any file <= CEILING=1000, so a ~6-line route change fits; logic lives in the new lib module.

autoDecisions.summary: createWorktree best-effort fetches +refs/heads/feature/<x>:refs/remotes/origin/feature/<x> before deciding whether the branch exists.
autoDecisions.rationale: Today an unfetched remote branch makes createWorktree run 'git worktree add -b feature/<x> … origin/main', cutting a new branch with the PR branch's name; adoption pre-fetches anyway, and the fix also corrects the manual pan workspace create path.

autoDecisions.summary: A webhook payload without pull_request.head.sha is refused (head-unknown); only the exact branch feature/<issue-lower> is adopted; polyrepo projects are refused.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue forbids adopting a branch whose head differs from the PR head, which cannot be checked without the SHA; the pipeline only verifies and pushes feature/<issue-lower>; polyrepo sub-repo adoption needs its own design.

autoDecisions.summary: The Kanban NeedsYouStrip / simple-mode projection is out of scope; Command Deck plus pan show carry the signal.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the plan inside the finalize size lint (≤25 files, ≤6 subsystems) while satisfying the acceptance criterion that the operator sees a Needs-you item naming the PR and the fix.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan-critic round 1 findings (5 blocks-the-design) all accepted and answered under '## Critique response' in the PRD.
autoDecisions.rationale: Each finding was verified against the cited code: the guard shortcuts precede workspace checks, the cached listing can hide new PRs and swallows failures, a post-adoption review refusal left no journal signal, a stale registry row skipped the .git check, and the diverged fix said branch -D.

metadata.sizeJustification: 26 files across 7 first-two-segment paths; the seventh, tests/cli, exists only because the pan show tests live in tests/cli/commands/show.test.ts, and package.json is touched only to add two frontend tests to the CI subset. Every slice serves the one behavior (an outside PR is adopted or its refusal is visible), each item is small, and the pan show change is 3 lines plus its test.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Create src/lib/cloister/pr-workspace-adoption.ts with AdoptablePr, AdoptionRefusal, AdoptionOutcome, AdoptionDeps, adoptPrWorkspace and adoptionRefusalFix. Run the ten steps in the exact PRD order: exact-branch check, head-sha check, project/polyrepo check, fetch +refs/heads/<branch>:refs/remotes/origin/<branch>, compare remote ref to pr.headSha, worktree prune + findBranchWorktree, local-branch rule (absent → git branch --track; equal → nothing; ancestor → git update-ref CAS; else refuse), createWorkspace, assert workspace HEAD and current branch, journal workspace.adopted. Failures with an existing workspace journal workspace.adoption-failed with data { prNumber, reason, detail, fix }. Never run push, --force, branch -D, worktree remove, or removeWorkspace. All git via promisified execFile argv. Fix texts per the WI-4 table. Tests use real git in temp dirs with an injected createWorkspace (runs git worktree add) and injected resolveProject. Mock the notifier in tests exactly as tests/unit/lib/cloister/review-verdict-feedback.test.ts does: vi.mock('<rel>/src/lib/pipeline-notifier.js', () => ({ notifyPipeline: vi.fn() })) so journal appends never reach the network. The local-branch-diverged fix text must never tell the operator to delete the branch: it says to inspect `git -C <projectPath> log <headSha>..<branch>`, push the commits to the PR or move them to another branch, then run pan review request (PRD WI-4 table).

items.title: Given a bare origin whose feature/pan-1 equals pr.headSha and no local branch, adoptPrWorkspace returns { adopted: true, workspacePath } and `git -C workspacePath rev-parse HEAD` equals pr.headSha and the workspace journal's last entry is workspace.adopted
Given feature/pan-1 checked out in another worktree of the primary clone, adoptPrWorkspace returns reason checked-out-elsewhere with that worktreePath and the injected createWorkspace is never called

Given origin's feature/pan-1 differs from pr.headSha it returns head-moved; given a local branch with an extra commit it returns local-branch-diverged and leaves the local ref unchanged; given a local ancestor it fast-forwards and adopts

When the injected createWorkspace creates the worktree but returns success: false, it returns create-failed and the workspace journal ends with workspace.adoption-failed whose data.fix contains `pan workspace create PAN-1`

Across all test cases the recorded git argv never contains push, --force, -D, or worktree remove, and no adoptionRefusalFix text contains `branch -D`, `--force`, or `reset --hard`; headSha undefined returns head-unknown and headRef strike/pan-1 returns not-feature-branch
Orchestrator: adopt, start review, journal and announce refusals, coalesce per issue, and answer the missing-workspace route

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Create src/lib/cloister/pr-adoption-review.ts exporting adoptPrAndStartReview (module-level Map<string, Promise> coalescing keyed by upper-case issue id, deleted in finally; __resetPrAdoptionForTests), findOpenPipelinePr (fresh branch-targeted `gh pr list --head <branch> --state open --limit 10 --json number,url,headRefName,headRefOid,isDraft` via runGh with caller 'pr-adoption'; returns { kind: 'found' | 'none' | 'error' }; GitLab project → none; never the cached repo listing), and answerMissingWorkspace(issueId, source, { derivedState, workspaceExists }) (null when the workspace exists or the issue is merged; 503 on lookup error; 400 + hint on none; 202 { success, queued, adopting: true, message } plus a detached adoptAndReview call on found). Refusal → one announce(issueId, `PR #<n> was not reviewed: <fix>`, details). Adopted → startReview(issueId, { note, source }); a null starter or a started:false answer appends workspace.adoption-failed to the adopted workspace with data.reason 'no-starter' or 'review-not-started', the starter's error text when present (e.g. dirty-workspace), and a fix, then announces it, so the derived attention stays on until a later review.requested. Any throw is caught and announced, never rethrown. Defaults: adoptPrWorkspace, getRequestReviewStarter(), surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou, appendPipelineEntry. Tests inject every dep (no git, no network).

items.title: When the injected adopt refuses with checked-out-elsewhere, adoptPrAndStartReview calls announce exactly once with a reason containing the PR number and the fix, never calls startReview, and returns kind refused

When adopt succeeds, startReview is called once with the issue id and { source, note mentioning the PR number }; started:true returns kind started; a { started: false, reason: 'dirty-workspace', error } answer records workspace.adoption-failed with reason review-not-started and the error text in the journal, announces it, and returns review-not-started; a null starter records reason no-starter
Two concurrent adoptPrAndStartReview calls for the same issue invoke adopt once and both resolve to the same outcome; an adopt that throws is caught, announced, and the call resolves

findOpenPipelinePr with an injected gh skips draft rows and rows on other branches, maps headRefOid to headSha, returns none for [] and error when gh rejects; answerMissingWorkspace returns null when the workspace exists or the issue is merged, 202 with adopting: true (calling adoptAndReview once) for an approved-PR derived state with no workspace, 400 with a hint for none, and 503 for error
